title: Favorite folders that are outside of the project are shown in FileSystem dock when it's in split mode
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6], v4.5.rc1.official [08e9e6b29] ### System information Godot v4.4.1.stable - Debian GNU/Linux 12 (bookworm) 12 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon R7 360 Series (RADV BONAIRE) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-3450 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) ### Issue description When you add a folder outside of the current project (e.g. when opening a file in script editor) to your favorites, it is displayed in the file list of the filesystem dock: Here I added /boot directory to my favorites. FileSystem dock does not display it in the tree view on the left, but _does_ display it in the file list when you click `Favorites` in the tree and the dock is in split mode. ### Steps to reproduce 1. In the script editor, click `File -> Open...` 2. Navigate outside of the project 3. Add a folder to your favorites 4. Change FileSystem dock to split mode 5. Click `Favorites` 6. Observe the result ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A --- Slightly unrelated, but when you try to delete this folder using the dock (not from favorites, but actually delete), Godot fails and display this weird error: `ERROR: Can't rename file "/home/ar/new-game-project/home/ar/test_folder" to "/home/ar/new-game-project/home/ar/test_folder"` The actual path to the folder is `/home/ar/test_folder`, but somehow Godot thinks it's in my project? Weird. And if you try to rename this folder using the dock, Godot crashes:
